I farm only 3.0 mu, and I have been doing this for a long time, so I will keep things simple, steady, and not too risky. I will stay with the wheat-maize rotation on all 3.0 mu because that fits my land, my labor, and the local climate in Quzhou County. Since I have well irrigation, I will use it at the key stages instead of gambling on rainfall. For wheat, I will use an improved variety, put on moderate fertilizer, irrigate a few times, and keep field management stable so I can protect yield without making the work too heavy. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because it gives better yield, and I will manage fertilizer and water carefully since summer maize responds well to both. I am old and the household is small, so I will not choose complicated or high-risk management. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and practical for a small farm like mine, and I will aim for reliable output more than chasing the very highest yield.
